integrity: Proof is a formal substitution induction. An exhaustive small-field checker gives corroboration, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Depth-one finite truncations in characteristic two; reduced loci only. Higher ramification depths, nonreduced equations and non-fields are outside scope. Independent mathematical validation and priority certification have not been performed.
title: Parity-obstructed lifting of depth-one involutions in truncated Nottingham groups
